== Purpose ==
A small "Can you help?" box for an article (usually an event page) that has open cases: people still to be named in its photographs, an entry on [[Mysteries]], or decklists on [[Unknown players]]. It links to the exact list section and to [[Help Complete the Archive]].

== Usage ==
<pre>{{Help wanted|text=16 people in the group photograph are still to be named.|photos=2025 World Championship}}</pre>
renders as:
{{Help wanted|text=16 people in the group photograph are still to be named.|photos=2025 World Championship}}

=== Parameters ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Meaning
|-
| <code>text</code> || One short sentence about what is open.
|-
| <code>photos</code> || Optional. Heading on [[Unidentified event photographs]] (usually the event name).
|-
| <code>mystery</code> || Optional. Heading of the entry on [[Mysteries]].
|-
| <code>decks</code> || Optional. Heading on [[Unknown players]].
|}

Place it under the infobox or at the top of the Photographs section. Remove it when every case it points to is solved.
